Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 4th-level spells

Benefit: As long as you have a healing spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you can spend a standard action to remove a status effect from a creature within 30 feet, based on the highest-level healing spell you can cast. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting healing spells.
